name: Cloud 9 Infused Preroll | Starburzt
description:
Starburzt

The mood-lifter. Starburst is a vibe-driven high: bright, balanced, and perfect for slipping into a dreamy zone. Candy profile with smooth exhale. Balanced hybrid for all-day vibes.

Flavor Profile: Juicy Citrus · Lime Zest · Pine Finish

Effects: Balanced High • Mellow Euphoria • Feel-Good

Primary Terpenes: d-Limonene, a-Terpineol, Citral
